result.name: add_component
result.description: Add a component with default values to an existing entity

result.name: animation
result.description: Inspect clips and fade progress, or play a named clip. Defaults: fade_seconds 0.25, looping true, speed 1. Positive fades reject an already active fade; zero switches immediately.

oneOf.description: List the entity's clips and inspect its playback and transition state.
Start a named clip, fading from the active clip when one exists.

result.name: behavior
result.description: Attach validated Luau scripts, configure particles and preview bursts. describe gives particle JSON and a script example. inspect returns attachments. set_script uses resource-relative scripts/name.luau, set_particles a full descriptor; null detaches. Authored changes are undoable in edit mode. IDs are decimal strings.

oneOf.description: A resource-relative scripts/*.luau path; null detaches the script.
Full scene particle descriptor; null detaches the emitter.

result.name: create_resource
result.description: Create a new resource file with optional template

result.name: destroy_entity
result.description: Remove an entity from the scene

result.name: duplicate_entity
result.description: Duplicate an entity with an optional position offset

result.name: editor_view
result.description: Read the shared editor viewport or move/focus/select once, then read back a fresh committed frame. Returns PNG plus camera, optional selection, projected frustum candidates, and GPU-picked center/pointer. Frustum intersection is NOT occlusion visibility or room membership. Do not edit ambiguous candidates without clarification. entity_id is the stable generational string from context; stale IDs fail. Undo/redo use agent history. Observe is available during Play/Pause; editing the view/history requires edit mode. Camera movement is ephemeral; manual input takes over immediately.

oneOf.description: Observe the next committed frame, including its image and geometric candidates.
Move once to a world-space pose. Manual navigation resumes immediately.
Change only the editor selection. Null clears it.
Fit the render bounds of an object in the editor view.
Undo the last agent scene operation using the editor's existing agent history.
Redo the last undone agent operation.

result.name: get_component_attributes
result.description: Get settable fields, types, and current values for a component on an entity

result.name: get_scene_hierarchy
result.description: Get the full scene hierarchy as JSON

result.name: list_available_components
result.description: List all registered component types with their settable fields and types

result.name: list_resources
result.description: List resource files in a project directory

result.name: load_scene
result.description: Load a scene from a .katla file, replacing all entities in the current scene

result.name: material
result.description: Discover presets, inspect an object material, or set PBR factors on 1..256 mesh objects as one undoable batch. Use action presets first. base_color is sRGB RGBA in 0..1. Partial patches preserve other factors; preset supplies defaults, explicit factors override it. Textures are preserved. Use query_entities to find objects and editor_view to see results.

MaterialPreset.description: Named starting points for room surfaces and props.

oneOf.description: List named presets and their PBR factors.
Read material factors on one object.
Patch any subset of factors on up to 256 objects as one undoable edit.

result.name: prefab
result.description: Author .katmesh and .katprefab assets. describe returns JSON examples; validate/write checks complete recipes; instantiate appends a preview; capture saves a live subtree; remove deletes a preview. Read/edit named parts, then observe editor_view for the rendered result. IDs are decimal strings; paths are project-relative.

oneOf.description: Returns the supported formats, JSON examples, limits and iteration workflow.
Export one live root and every descendant; references must remain internal.
Remove a preview root and every descendant, retaining other instances.

result.name: query_entities
result.description: Query entities by component type

result.name: read_resource
result.description: Read a resource file's content as text

result.name: save_scene
result.description: Save the current scene to a .katla file

result.name: search_assets
result.description: Find project assets recursively by words in their paths and optional extensions. Example query chair, extensions [glb,gltf]. Returns sorted resource-relative paths ready for spawn_model, total and truncation. Empty query lists assets; never invent model filenames.

extensions.description: File extensions without dots, e.g. ["glb", "gltf"] for models.

limit.description: Maximum results, default 64 and capped at 256.

query.description: Case-insensitive words to match anywhere in the relative asset path.

result.name: set_field
result.description: Set a component field value on an entity

result.name: set_parent
result.description: Set or clear the parent of an entity

result.name: simulation
result.description: Inspect or explicitly play/pause/resume/stop the editor preview. Stop restores authored state and replaces runtime IDs; query again afterward. Use play to verify scripts and triggers, stop before saving or prefab capture.

result.name: spawn_entity
result.description: Spawn a new entity in the scene with a transform

result.name: spawn_model
result.description: Spawn a GLTF model using a resource-relative path returned by search_assets

result.name: trigger
result.description: Create a sensor box, replace its enter/exit rules, or inspect rules and overlaps. Actions play named animations, burst/toggle particle emitters, or emit Luau events. Entity IDs are decimal generational strings from scene context; use other to act on the visitor. Rules run in play mode.

EventAction.description: A semantic action, executed in list order after physics finishes its step.

oneOf.description: Reuses the engine's named animation playback and fade contract.
Queue a bounded burst on a particle emitter.
Enable or disable an existing particle emitter.
Delivers a named Luau event with trigger_entity and other_entity fields.

EventTarget.description: An action's recipient. Scene files use document keys; live rules use generational IDs.

TriggerPhase.description: Overlap transition that activates a rule.

TriggerRule.description: A trigger's event, optional visitor filter and ordered actions.

once.description: Runs once per play session, consumed when matched even if an action fails.

result.name: write_resource
result.description: Write content to an existing resource file

data.scope: Per-object multipliers; textures and mesh geometry are preserved.

data.spatial_contract: Distance to render bounds if available, otherwise transform origin. No frustum or room-membership restriction.
